sections.description:
PRESIDENT'S ORDER 9 OF 1991
PRESIDENT'S ORDER
9 OF 1991
SALARY OF JUDGES
OF SUPERIOR COURTS ORDER, 1991
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 25th November, 1991]
No. F. 2(2)/91-Pub, dated
25-11-1991:-----The following Order made by the President is hereby
published for general information:--
Whereas the first paragraph of
the Fifth Schedule to the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan
relating to the Supreme Court and the High Court provides that such higher
salary than that specified in the said paragraph shah be paid to a Judge of the
Supreme Court or a High Court as the President may, from time tea time,
determine-
Now, Therefore, in exercise of
the powers conferred by the aforesaid paragraph, the President is pleased to
make the following Order:-
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Order may be called the Salary of Judges of
Superior Courts Order, 1991.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on the first day of June, 1991.
2. Salary.--(1) The salary
to be paid per mensem to the Chief Justice of Pakistan shall be Rs.15,000 and
that to be so paid to every other Judge of the Supreme Court Shall be
Rs.14,200.
(2) The salary to be paid per
mensem to the Chief Justice of a High Court shall be Rs.14,000 and that to be
so paid to every other Judge of a High Court shall be Rs.12,575.
